name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SaaS Account Management | Full-Cycle Expansion, Retention & Enterprise Relationships
summary: SaaS account manager and full-cycle seller with 15+ years growing mid-market and enterprise software accounts. Ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, retained all but one of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye, and held 120% of sales targets at Wix. Sells to and expands inside complex organizations, multi-threading from end users to procurement to the C-suite, and runs the whole cycle: prospecting, qualification, demo, negotiation, and close. Denver based, entrepreneurial by track record as the founder of a marketing operations practice, and fluent in the account data that shows where expansion and churn risk actually sit.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Identify expansion opportunities inside an existing client base, scoping and closing complementary services aligned to each client's objectives.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of business clients, running discovery to surface goals, structure, and buying patterns.
Build account-level scoring logic that evaluates a company's digital footprint to prioritize outreach, including an audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts.
Run day-to-day delivery on complex SaaS platforms, driving adoption and measurable outcomes rather than handing off after the sale.
Build dashboards tracking pipeline velocity, funnel progression, and campaign ROI, and report results directly to business owners.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, acting as strategic lead and coordinating execution across internal departments.
Built performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering recommendations and quarterly business reviews.
Held delivery quality consistent across accounts, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners with deal sizes of ~$10K-$45K, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Drove rapid adoption of marketing automation and reputation management software across a diverse, high-volume partner network.
Routed structured, high-priority customer feedback to Product and Engineering, connecting field signals to roadmap decisions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each, several exceeding $25K, for roughly $130K+ in total bookings over a short tenure.
Ran client accounts end to end, covering execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding and launching 25+ clients per month.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for two years, a team of 20 and later a team of 8, overseeing scope and delivery.
Drove team initiatives for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, training, and sales training for tenured account executives.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled.
Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, closing deals of $20K and larger later in tenure.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, performing consistently into accelerator commission tiers.
Built C-suite relationships as a trusted advisor on operational system design, guiding onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations.
Escalated risk early and mitigated account-level exposure with direct strategic guidance.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales for a loyalty and marketing automation platform, covering high-volume prospecting, qualification, and customer acquisition.
